analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the Financial Year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. Management presented details regarding the adoption of audited financial statements, along with resolutions for the re-appointment of directors and independent directors. The document outlines administrative procedures for remote e-voting, virtual attendance via video conferencing, and statutory disclosures concerning board composition and governance. In the Annual Report for FY 2024-25, California Software Company Limited emphasized its strategic focus on empowering small and microbusinesses through accessible artificial intelligence (AI) solutions and platforms. Management highlighted the surge in global AI adoption and detailed the company's initiatives including the expansion of dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted an unprecedented surge in AI adoption among small businesses globally, with about 68% reporting usage.
demand_outlook.quote: The past year witnessed an unprecedented surge in AI adoption among small businesses globally. About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior.

demand_outlook.claim: An additional 9% of small business owners planned to begin using AI within the next year.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

demand_outlook.claim: Approximately 80% of small business owners surveyed viewed AI as an enabler enhancing their workforce rather than a replacement.
demand_outlook.quote: Crucially, most entrepreneurs see AI as an enabler of growth rather than a threat: around 80% say AI is enhancing (not replacing) their workforce, and nearly 40% plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.

orders_capacity.claim: dSpeedUp's digital ecosystem expanded to serve over 1,000 merchants.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Many small enterprises still faced resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively. This presents both a challenge and an opportunity – one that Calsoft has proactively addressed through accessible technology and client support.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry surveys noted that 42% of small businesses reported lacking the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
